Name: Harem Valley (SVE Compatibility)
Author: Eli0630
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
I saw that the Harem Valley mod didn't have the SVE characters, so I decided to make it. Also, the Valley Girls SVE mod I made wasn't compatible with that mod, so this is an alternative.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Install this mod along with the requirements for it to work, paste or import the mods into SMAPI or the mods folder, start the game and it should work.
*NOTE:Do not install this mod alongside Harem Valley: technically it's the same mod, it just adds Sophia and Olivia from SVE, so there's no point in having both. Plus, it could cause conflicts and errors.*
[b]DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD WITH VORTEX[/b]
Downloading the mod using Vortex causes errors in the mod (this also happens with other mods from other sources).
